question: Can a text-to-multi-view diffusion model, fine-tuned from a 2D text-to-image model on 3D renders plus 2D data, act as a 3D prior that removes the multi-face Janus and content drift problems of 2D-lifting text-to-3D?
hypothesis: Even a perfect camera-conditioned single-view model is not sufficient; jointly generating consistent views with cross-view (3D) attention gives both consistency and generalisability.
contributions: Multi-view diffusion model generating consistent multi-view images from text, trained on 3D renders and 2D image-text pairs
Use as a 3D prior via SDS (x0-reconstruction loss), more stable than 2D-lifting methods
Multi-view DreamBooth for personalized 3D generation from a few 2D images

method.summary: Stable Diffusion 2.1 base is fine-tuned to denoise 4 orthogonal views jointly by inflating 2D self-attention to 3D (all views attend to each other) and adding a 2-layer-MLP camera embedding added to the time embedding; 70% of batches are Objaverse renders, 30% LAION 2D. The model replaces SD in threestudio SDS to optimise a hash-grid NeRF; a DreamBooth variant fine-tunes it on identity images.
method.task: text-to-multi-view image generation; text-to-3D via score distillation sampling; personalised 3D generation

datasets.name: Objaverse (filtered)
datasets.size: about 350K objects; each rendered twice with different random settings; 32 azimuths per render
datasets.split: held-out validation set (size not stated); 1,000 validation subjects used for Table 1
datasets.preprocessing: Names and tags as text; CLIP-score filter of irrelevant objects; object centred in [-0.5,0.5] box; fov in [15,60], elevation in [0,30], distance scale in [0.9,1.1]; random Blender HDRI; RGBA with random grayscale background; ', 3d asset' appended if '3d' not in prompt; 4x4 camera params normalised onto sphere (rotation only)

datasets.name: LAION subset
datasets.preprocessing: no multi-view; 3D attention and camera embedding turned off

datasets.name: 40 text prompts for text-to-3D
datasets.source: prior studies, internet image-generation prompts, user inputs from a 3D generation website (Luma)

models.name: MVDream multi-view diffusion
models.architecture: SD 2.1 UNet; self-attention inflated to 3D over F views (B x FHW x C); camera MLP (2-layer) embedding added to time embedding
models.context: 4 views at 256x256 (main); 8 views at 512x512 over 90 degrees in the attention ablation

models.name: dreamfusion-IF, magic3d-IF-SD, textmesh-IF, prolificdreamer (threestudio re-implementations)
models.architecture: DeepFloyd guidance (Magic3D variant uses SD per name); hash-grid NeRF except TextMesh (SDF)

training.objective: epsilon-prediction MSE, L_MV = E||eps - eps_theta(x_t; y, c, t)||^2; with 30% chance trained as 2D text-to-image on LAION. DreamBooth: L_LDM + lambda*||theta-theta0||_1/N_theta, lambda=1
training.optimizer: inferred: Stable Diffusion settings kept ('keep their settings for the optimizer'); exact optimiser not named for diffusion training
training.lr: DreamBooth: 2e-6; diffusion pretraining lr not stated

other.mode_sampling: mode<=0.7 -> 3D sample, 4 random orthogonal views of 32; else 4 LAION images, c empty (Algorithm 1)
other.sds_optimisation: threestudio implicit-volume (hash-grid + MLP); 10,000 steps AdamW lr 0.01; max/min timestep annealed 0.98->0.5 and 0.02 over first 8,000 steps; CFG rescale factor 0.5; render res 64x64 -> 256x256 after 5,000 steps; soft shading on after 5,000 steps; background replaced with 50% chance; about 1.5 h on a V100 with shading, 1 h without
other.sds_loss: x0-reconstruction loss, equivalent to SDS with w(t)=2 sigma_t/alpha_t; orientation loss only; point lighting and soft shading; no sparsity loss; negative prompts fixed (text not given)

inference.samples: Table 1: 4-view images for 1,000 validation subjects; text-to-3D: 40 prompts, one model each (seed count not stated)
inference.prompting: ', 3d asset' appended to text for generation; original prompts (no direction-annotated prompts) in SDS

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: Frechet Inception Distance of generated 4-view images (1,000 held-out subjects)

metrics.name: CLIP score
metrics.definition: text-image consistency averaged across all views and subjects

metrics.name: User preference
metrics.definition: each user sees 5 rendered videos with text and picks preferred 3D model

eval.protocol: Table 1 on 1,000 held-out subjects; 40-prompt text-to-3D comparison and user study with 914 feedbacks from 38 users; no seeds or significance tests; qualitative ablations on attention type, number of views (1, 2, 4), SDS tricks.

results.claim: 1-view model still has severe Janus problem; 4-view model barely suffers consistency issues (qualitative, Fig 8).
results.setup: SDS with models trained with 1, 2, 4 views, all with camera embeddings
results.quote: Finally, the 4-view model barely suffers from any multi-view consistency issues.

results.claim: Inflated 3D self-attention beats temporal attention and an added 3D attention module (qualitative).
results.quote: The proposed strategy of inflated 2D self-attention achieves the best consistency among all without losing generation quality.

results.quote: it able to generate 64 views and potentially more, even though it is trained on 4 views
